suite: G3 Users & Organizations + G4 Client Directory
observations: G3/G4 run also confirms the multi-tenant fix: member and client reads from another organization answer 404, and allOrganizations=true is ADMIN-scoped to the caller own tenants.

results.title: Bootstrap: two independent organizations, each with one ADMIN
GET /users/me/organizations lists only the caller own organizations
GET /users returns a paginated directory without credentials
POST /users creates members and applies the VIEWER default role
POST /users rejects duplicates, unknown roles and weak passwords
RBAC: a VIEWER may read the directory but not write it
notes: This operation requires one of the following roles: ADMIN, PRESALE_LEAD.

results.title: GET /users filters by search, role and status and validates the enum
notes: enum and range guards return 400, never 500

results.title: allOrganizations=true is ADMIN-only and stays inside the ADMIN own tenants
notes: 403 for VIEWER; ADMIN scope limited to organizations the caller belongs to

results.title: GET /users/:id resolves in-tenant members and hides foreign ones as 404
notes: foreign member answers 404 rather than 403, so existence is not disclosed

results.title: PATCH /users/:id updates a member and requires at least one field
An ADMIN cannot change their own role or status
notes: Change your own role or status from another administrator account.

results.title: The last active ADMIN cannot be demoted or deactivated by a PRESALE_LEAD
notes: The organization must keep at least one active ADMIN.

results.title: Deactivating a member kills their existing session and blocks new logins
PATCH /users/me edits profile fields and ignores role/status escalation
notes: role/status keys in the body are not writable here

results.title: Changing my password proves the current one and revokes other sessions
Every directory endpoint requires authentication
notes: 401 on all four, no anonymous write path

results.title: POST /clients creates a client with the documented defaults
Client writes validate the taxonomy and required fields
RBAC: a VIEWER can read clients but not create, update or delete them
notes: This operation requires one of the following roles: ADMIN, PRESALE_LEAD.

results.title: GET /clients paginates, searches case-insensitively and filters by industry
Search input with SQL/ILIKE metacharacters is escaped, not interpreted
notes: bare % returns 0 rows, so LIKE wildcards are escaped

results.title: GET /clients/:id resolves in-tenant rows and hides foreign ones as 404
notes: cross-tenant read/patch/delete all answer 404 and change nothing

results.title: PATCH /clients/:id updates partially and bounds field lengths
notes: 255-column email rejected at the boundary with 400, not a 500 from PostgreSQL

results.title: A client referenced by a lead cannot be deleted (409) and its leads are listable
notes: 409 message: Reassign the 1 lead(s) attached to this client before deleting it.

results.title: Unknown or foreign UUID references on a lead are refused with 400
notes: no FK violation reaches the client as a 500

results.title: DELETE /clients/:id returns 204 and is not replayable
notes: second delete is 404, not a silent success

results.title: Client mutations are recorded in the audit trail
Audit read is ADMIN/PRESALE_LEAD-only and never writable over HTTP
